panels.title: Overall — Run B vs Run A

targets.query: SELECT percentile("pct95.0",95) as "p95 A", sum("count") as "# A" FROM "$measurement_name" WHERE "statut"='all' AND "transaction" =~ /^TX_/ AND "application"='$run_a' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1000d)
SELECT sum("countError") as "errc A", sum("count") as "cnt A" FROM "$measurement_name" WHERE "statut"='all' AND "transaction"='all' AND "application"='$run_a' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1000d)

SELECT percentile("pct95.0",95) as "p95 B", sum("count") as "# B" FROM "$measurement_name" WHERE "statut"='all' AND "transaction" =~ /^TX_/ AND "application"='$run_b' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1000d)

SELECT mean("r") as "rps A" FROM (SELECT sum("count")/$send_interval AS r FROM "$measurement_name" WHERE "statut"='all' AND "transaction" =~ /^TX_/ AND "application"='$run_a' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(${send_interval}s)) GROUP BY time(1000d)

SELECT mean("r") as "rps B" FROM (SELECT sum("count")/$send_interval AS r FROM "$measurement_name" WHERE "statut"='all' AND "transaction" =~ /^TX_/ AND "application"='$run_b' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(${send_interval}s)) GROUP BY time(1000d)
